Club selection comparison

Research prototype — the main scoring model is unchanged.

Compare several feasible clubs at each fixed target. Lower estimated strokes is better. Each row uses three independent sets of 4,000 shots, with the same misses across choices.

Important: reduced swings use the existing proportional spread assumption. That is not measured evidence. Only clubs requiring 75–100% of stock carry are shown; this threshold is an experimental scope limit, not a recommendation. Small differences may be near-equivalent. These are fixed targets, not a search for the best possible shot.

The dogleg uses the two original owner-review targets. Their routes through the trees are not physically validated. This model does not simulate airborne tree clearance. All costs use the existing Tour reference.
